The “Vanilla” model, shown as a purple solid line with no markers, starts at approximately 3.4 at iteration 0 and decreases to about 2.5 by iteration 140,000. The “SepLLM (n=128)” model, depicted as a dark blue solid line, begins at 3.4 and declines to approximately 2.6 by iteration 140,000. All lines exhibit a steep initial drop in loss followed by a more gradual decline, with the “Vanilla” and “SepLLM (n=64, H/T)” models showing the lowest final loss values.
